faqData.question: Can you reuse the displays and cabling we already have?
faqData.answer: Yes, existing cabling and hardware can often be repurposed if they pass site testing. Our team evaluates installed infrastructure to determine what remains usable. Most project upgrades focus on replacing outdated smart screens for classrooms, while existing infrastructure continues to support your broader classroom AV solutions.

faqData.question: Do you visit the campus before sending a quotation?
faqData.answer: Yes, pre-quote site visits are standard practice for every project. Engineers inspect room dimensions, power points, and network drops before finalizing prices. This evaluation allows us to quote college AV solutions customized to your physical space and reduces mid-project cost adjustments.

faqData.question: Can the rollout be phased across academic years?
faqData.answer: Yes. You can upgrade high-priority rooms first and expand your AV solutions for classroom setups as budgets become available. Each phase follows the same technical design, making sure teachers find familiar controls in every completed room.

faqData.question: Do you work with universities as well as schools?
faqData.answer: Yes, we serve K-12 schools as well as colleges and universities. Our AV solutions for colleges follow the same planning process as our school projects. Lecture halls and hybrid rooms in our AV solutions for higher education can also incorporate advanced technologies like multi-screen setups and beamforming ceiling microphone arrays.

faqData.question: Can installation happen outside school hours?
faqData.answer: Yes. We schedule installations during evenings, weekends, or school holidays so daily classes run without interruption. Project leaders coordinate specific access windows directly with your authorized team prior to commencing work.

faqData.question: How long does a full campus rollout take?
faqData.answer: Single classrooms take one to three days. Larger deployments take several weeks as we work, building by building. Whether deploying a single campus AV solution or managing broader AV in colleges, every project includes a dedicated testing phase before final sign-off.

faqData.question: Will the rooms work with the video platform we already use?
faqData.answer: Yes. We install cameras and microphones certified for major platforms like Teams, Zoom, and Google Meet. Compatibility is verified during design, and we configure the room accounts and licenses each platform needs for your AV solutions in smart classrooms.

faqData.question: Is ongoing support included after installation?
faqData.answer: No, ongoing support is provided only under an Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC). An AMC keeps your AV integrated smart classroom in good condition through preventive visits and SLA-backed responses. Irrespective of AMC, each project includes staff training and full documentation at handover.

faqData.question: What warranty covers the equipment?
faqData.answer: Hardware carries standard manufacturer coverage, which typically spans one to five years depending on the vendor. Our team logs product warranty dates during final handover and helps process replacement claims directly with manufacturers whenever issues arise.

faqData.question: Can you work with our in-house IT team?
faqData.answer: Yes. Engineers coordinate network details with your IT team during the design phase, and your staff retains full admin control over all classroom AV solutions after handover.
